info.name: SS-6438 — Build UPG itineraries as main itineraries with NGS children (regular + upgrade options)
info.description: Consolidated approved scope: 13 merge-enabled Search rows and two merge-disabled SS-6437 baseline rows. Run CSV rows grouped by mode, manually verifying matching CID mergeWithRegular=true for merge_enabled or false for legacy_disabled before each group. BCKDCR secondBag/keepBothBagOptions=false; AKKDCR both true. No configuration changes are performed by this collection. The positive regular-cheapest and complete pre-filter checks are excluded from sign-off; unsuccessful exploratory Searches are not included. Existing PREPROD environment supplies search_authorization at runtime. Includes one extra_false row: BCKDCR mergeWithRegular=true with extra=false must expose no NGS child options or offer identifiers. Metadata is not counted as itinerary options.

exec: for (const key of required) { const v=pm.iterationData.get(key); if (v===undefined || v==='') throw new Error('CSV row missing '+key); pm.variables.set(key,v); }
if (!String(pm.variables.get('search_url')).startsWith('http://airapi51.kivops.info/v1/search?')) throw new Error('Search URL outside the approved host/endpoint');
if (!['merge_enabled','legacy_disabled','extra_false'].includes(pm.iterationData.get('mode'))) throw new Error('Missing or invalid CSV mode');
function at(obj, path) { return String(path).split('.').reduce((a, k) => a == null ? undefined : a[k], obj); }
const upg = o => at(o, markerPath) !== undefined;
console.warn('WARN/NO_DATA: no qualifying UPG groups; merge checks cannot be evaluated.');
pm.test('Retained groups follow the scoped merge rules', () => {
if (!parents.length) { console.warn('WARN: legacy UPG inventory unavailable'); pm.test.skip('Legacy UPG inventory available',()=>{}); }

else if (pm.iterationData.get('cid')==='BCKDCR') pm.test('SS-6437 BCKDCR main identifiers',()=>{for(const r of body.results)pm.expect(String(r.gdsOfferId||'').includes(':UPG#')&&String(r.gdsOfferId||'').includes(':NGS#')).to.equal(false);});

else pm.test('SS-6437 AKKDCR child identifiers',()=>{for(const r of parents){pm.expect(r.ngsItineraries).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty;for(const c of r.ngsItineraries){pm.expect(String(c.gdsOfferId||'').includes(':UPG#')).to.equal(true);pm.expect(String(c.gdsOfferId||'').includes(':NGS#')).to.equal(true);}}});
